CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.tasks_enforce_entry_state()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.state not in ('queued','needs_approval') then
    raise exception
      'task cannot be created in state %; entry states are queued and needs_approval',
      new.state
      using errcode = 'check_violation';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
